pd1_rule: A macrophage is drawn PD1+ when its PD1 is above the cohort mean (cohort z-score > 0, the same z the feature averages; about 20% of Charville macrophages). The feature itself uses no threshold: it is the mean PD1 z of each Tumor 5 cell's macrophages within 100 um, averaged over the patient's Tumor 5 cells.
window_rule: 500 um square on a 25 um grid over every region; picked for the most PD1+ macrophages within 100 um of a Tumor 5 cell, both inside the window (102); first such window in region, x, y order.

km.split: median of the per-patient feature value
km.split_rule: high = value > median, low = value <= median
km.label: MEASURED
km.note: exploratory, cutoff chosen on the same cohort, no p-value

meta.source: Charville CODEX (Zenodo 13179600, CC-BY-4.0; Wu et al. 2022), real cells
